case_name: A 60-second single take that the free plan has to make in two generations: does the second continue the first?
title: Night ride, a 60 s single take
tests: Tests continuity across a length the free plan cannot make in one generation on every model: whether the second clip continues the first without a visible seam (the same rider, jacket, bike, weather and light), and whether the piece reads as one take.

faults.what: The supplied audio transcription contains speech: "Bapak-bapak sedang bekerja di sawah." This directly violates the ambient-sound-only and no-speech requirements.

judge.summary: The clip shows a yellow-jacketed courier cycling along wet nighttime streets, but contains forbidden speech and does not establish the requested bridge opening or café dismount in the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: One continuous take: no visible cut, jump or change of scene anywhere, including at the midpoint.
must_haves.why: The sampled views could belong to a continuous tracking shot, but four still frames cannot establish uninterrupted continuity or rule out a midpoint cut.

must_haves.item: The same rider in the same yellow rain jacket on the same bike from the first second to the last.
must_haves.why: The helmeted rider, yellow jacket and dark bicycle appear consistent across the samples, but the first and last seconds and intervening footage are not shown.

must_haves.item: It starts with her crossing a bridge and ends with her stopping at the lit door of a small café and stepping off the bike.
must_haves.why: No bridge appears in the supplied frames. A lit doorway is visible later, but it is not identifiable as a café, and the rider is still mounted at 54.3 seconds. The actual opening and ending are not provided.

must_haves.item: Rain and night throughout, with consistent light.
must_haves.why: The samples consistently show nighttime lighting and wet, reflective streets. They do not clearly establish falling rain throughout the clip.
The reported duration is 62.1 seconds, and the supplied frames are approximately 16:9 with a live-action appearance.

must_haves.item: Ambient sound only: no music, no speech, no text on screen.
must_haves.why: Speech is explicitly reported in the audio transcription. No readable on-screen text appears in the supplied frames; music cannot be assessed from the transcription.
